title: Our Neighbour, the River
question: Why had the neighbours left their farm?

meanings.usage: 指两个地区或区域之间的界限
指在同一职位或角色上之前的人
河流中水流缓慢或静止的区域
液体超出容器或河岸的界限
grapple with something 表示努力处理棘手问题
由木材绑在一起做成的水上交通工具
形容视野开阔，涵盖范围广
at this juncture 表示在这个关键时刻
指整体中的份额或比率
表示最崇高或最重要的

examples.en: The river has always played an important part in our lives.
examples.zh: 这条河在我们的生活中一直扮演着重要的角色。

examples.en: Without it we could not make a living.
examples.zh: 没有它，我们无法谋生。

examples.en: We took turns in watching that point.
examples.zh: 我们轮流监视那个地点。

examples.en: The men waded down with boat hooks in the hope of being able to grapple a corner of the raft.
examples.zh: 男人们涉水走下去，带着船钩，希望能够抓住木筏的一角。

examples.en: The floods had put the telephone out of order.
examples.zh: 洪水使电话出了故障。

examples.en: Flooding can sometimes spell disaster for their owners.
examples.zh: 洪水有时会给农场主带来灾难。

examples.en: At the most critical juncture we took turns in watching that point.
examples.zh: 在最关键的时刻，我们轮流监视那个地点。

examples.en: A raft appeared, looking rather like Noah's ark.
examples.zh: 一个木筏出现了，看起来有点像诺亚方舟。

examples.en: We stood to lose little.
examples.zh: 我们损失不大。

examples.en: The lower fields make up a very small proportion of our farm.
examples.zh: 地势较低的田地只占我们农场的一小部分。

sentences.en: The river which forms the eastern boundary of our farm has always played an important part in our lives.
sentences.zh: 构成了我们农场东部边界的河流，在我们的生活中一直扮演着重要的角色。

sentences.en: Without it we could not make a living.
sentences.zh: 没有它，我们就无法谋生。

sentences.en: There is only enough spring water to supply the needs of the house so we have to pump from the river for farm use.
sentences.zh: 泉水仅够供应房屋使用，所以农场用水必须从河里抽。

sentences.en: We tell the river all our secrets.
sentences.zh: 我们向河流倾诉我们所有的秘密。

sentences.en: We know instinctively, just as beekeepers with their bees,
sentences.zh: 我们本能地知道，就像养蜂人对他们的蜜蜂一样，

sentences.en: that misfortune might overtake us if the important events of our lives were not related to it.
sentences.zh: 如果我们生活中的重要事件不与河流相关，不幸可能会降临到我们身上。

sentences.en: We have special river birthday parties in the summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天我们会在河边举行特别的生日派对。

sentences.en: Sometimes we go upstream to a favourite backwater,
sentences.zh: 有时我们逆流而上到我们最喜欢的一个回水湾，

sentences.en: sometimes we have our party at the boathouse,
sentences.zh: 有时我们会在船屋举行派对，

sentences.en: which a predecessor of ours at the farm built in the meadow hard by the deepest pool for swimming and diving.
sentences.zh: 那是我们在农场的前任在草地边上，紧邻最深的游泳和跳水池建造的。

sentences.en: In a heat wave we choose a midnight birthday party and that is the most exciting of all.
sentences.zh: 在热浪来袭时，我们选择举行午夜生日派对，那是所有派对中最令人兴奋的。

sentences.en: We welcome the seasons by the riverside, crowning the youngest girl with flowers in the spring,
sentences.zh: 我们在河边迎接季节，春天给最小的女孩戴上花冠，

sentences.en: holding a summer festival on Midsummer Eve, giving thanks for the harvest in the autumn, and throwing a holly wreath into the current in the winter.
sentences.zh: 在仲夏夜举行夏季节庆，秋天感谢丰收，冬天则将冬青花环抛入水流中。

sentences.en: After a long period of rain the river may overflow its banks.
sentences.zh: 经过长时间的降雨，河流可能会泛滥。

sentences.en: This is a rare occurrence as our climate seldom goes to extremes.
sentences.zh: 这很少发生，因为我们这里的气候很少出现极端情况。

sentences.en: We are lucky in that only the lower fields,
sentences.zh: 我们很幸运，只有较低的田地，

sentences.en: which make up a very small proportion of our farm, are affected by flooding,
sentences.zh: 这只占我们农场很小的一部分，会受到洪水的影响，

sentences.en: but other farms are less favourably sited, and flooding can sometimes spell disaster for their owners.
sentences.zh: 但其他农场的位置不太好，洪水有时会给他们的主人带来灾难。

sentences.en: One bad winter we watched the river creep up the lower meadows.
sentences.zh: 一个糟糕的冬天，我们看着河水悄悄漫上了低洼的草地。

sentences.en: All the cattle had been moved into stalls and we stood to lose little.
sentences.zh: 所有的牛都已移入畜栏，我们几乎没什么损失。

sentences.en: We were, however, worried about our nearest neighbours, whose farm was low lying and who were newcomers to the district.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们担心我们最近的邻居，他们的农场地势低洼，而且他们是这个地区的新来者。

sentences.en: As the floods had put the telephone out of order, we could not find out how they were managing.
sentences.zh: 由于洪水导致电话失灵，我们无法了解他们的情况。

sentences.en: From an attic window we could get a sweeping view of the river where their land joined ours,
sentences.zh: 从阁楼窗户，我们可以俯瞰河流，看到他们的土地与我们农场相接之处，

sentences.en: and at the most critical juncture we took turns in watching that point.
sentences.zh: 在最关键的时刻，我们轮流守望那个地方。

sentences.en: The first sign of disaster was a dead sheep floating down.
sentences.zh: 灾难的第一个迹象是一只死羊顺流而下。

sentences.en: Next came a horse, swimming bravely,
sentences.zh: 接着来了一匹马，勇敢地游着，

sentences.en: but we were afraid that the strength of the current would prevent its landing anywhere before it became exhausted.
sentences.zh: 但我们担心水流太急，它在筋疲力尽之前无法靠岸。

sentences.en: Suddenly a raft appeared, looking rather like Noah's ark, carrying the whole family, a few hens, the dogs, a cat, and a bird in a cage.
sentences.zh: 突然，一个木筏出现了，看起来很像诺亚方舟，上面载着全家人、几只母鸡、狗、猫和一只笼子里的鸟。

sentences.en: We realized that they must have become unduly frightened by the rising flood,
sentences.zh: 我们意识到他们一定是过度被上涨的洪水吓到了，

sentences.en: for their house, which had sound foundations, would have stood stoutly even if it had been almost submerged.
sentences.zh: 因为他们的房子地基牢固，即使几乎被淹没，也能坚固地屹立不倒。

sentences.en: The men of our family waded down through our flooded meadows with boat hooks,
sentences.zh: 我们家的男人们带着船钩，趟过被淹没的草地，

sentences.en: in the hope of being able to grapple a corner of the raft and pull it out of the current towards our bank.
sentences.zh: 希望能钩住木筏的一角，把它从水流中拉到我们这边的岸边。

sentences.en: We still think it a miracle that they were able to do so.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然认为他们能做到这一点是个奇迹。

exercises.prompt: “时刻，关头” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: juncture · /ˈdʒʌŋktʃə(r)/ · noun · 时刻，关头。at this juncture 表示在这个关键时刻

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：涉水，趟水

exercises.prompt: “用来修饰名词或代词的从句，为句子提供必要的限定信息，不能省略。由关系代词（who, whom, which, that）或关系副词（where, when, why）引导。” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: 主句 + 关系代词/副词 + 从句
options: 定语从句中的“介词+which”结构
关系从句（限制性定语从句）
exercises.explain: 关系从句（限制性定语从句）：主句 + 关系代词/副词 + 从句：当先行词是物时，用which或that；当先行词是人时，用who, whom或that。关系副词where代替介词+which表示地点。

source.title: 关系从句（限制性定语从句）

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
We still think it a miracle that they were able to do so.
options: 没找到什么有价值的东西，
我们仍然认为他们能做到这一点是个奇迹。
他挣的钱将只有以前的一半，但他觉得地位的提升，很值得损失这点钱。
幸运的是，正当我不知下一步该怎么办的时候，
exercises.explain: We still think it a miracle that they were able to do so. — 我们仍然认为他们能做到这一点是个奇迹。

source.en: We still think it a miracle that they were able to do so.

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时间点之前已经完成的动作，强调'过去的过去'。常与一般过去时连用，构成时间上的先后关系。
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于叙述两个过去的动作，先发生的动作用过去完成时，后发生的动作用一般过去时。也用于after, before, when, as soon as等时间连词引导的复合句中。

examples.en: After the floods had put the telephone out of order, we could not find out how they were managing.
examples.zh: 洪水使电话出现故障后，我们无法了解他们如何应对。

examples.en: We realized that they must have become unduly frightened by the rising flood.
examples.zh: 我们意识到他们一定是因上涨的洪水而过度惊慌了。

grammar.title: 关系从句（限制性定语从句）
grammar.definition: 用来修饰名词或代词的从句，为句子提供必要的限定信息，不能省略。由关系代词（who, whom, which, that）或关系副词（where, when, why）引导。
grammar.structure: 主句 + 关系代词/副词 + 从句
grammar.usage: 当先行词是物时，用which或that；当先行词是人时，用who, whom或that。关系副词where代替介词+which表示地点。

examples.en: The river which forms the eastern boundary of our farm has always played an important part in our lives.
examples.zh: 形成我们农场东边边界的这条河在我们的生活中一直扮演着重要的角色。

examples.en: We went upstream to a favourite backwater, where we sometimes had our party.
examples.zh: 我们有时会到上游一个喜欢的回水湾去，在那里举办聚会。

grammar.title: 情态动词must have done（对过去事实的肯定推测）
grammar.definition: must + have + 过去分词表示对过去发生的事情的肯定推测，意为'一定...'。否定推测用can't have done，意为'不可能...'。
grammar.structure: 主语 + must have + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于对过去发生的事实进行有把握的推测，语气较强。

examples.en: We realized that they must have become unduly frightened by the rising flood.
examples.zh: 我们意识到他们一定是因上涨的洪水而过度惊慌了。

examples.en: He must have passed the exam because he studied so hard.
examples.zh: 他一定通过考试了，因为他学习很努力。

patterns.pattern: The river which/that + 动词...has always played an important part in our lives.

original.en: The river which forms the eastern boundary of our farm has always played an important part in our lives.
original.zh: 形成我们农场东边边界的这条河在我们的生活中一直扮演着重要的角色。

examples.en: The tree that stands in our garden has always provided us with shade in summer.
examples.zh: 长在我们花园里的那棵树在夏天一直为我们提供阴凉。

examples.en: The tradition which our family keeps has always played an important part in our life.
examples.zh: 我们家族保持的传统在我们的生活中一直扮演着重要的角色。

patterns.pattern: Without + 名词, we could not/couldn't + 动词原形.

original.en: Without it we could not make a living.

examples.en: Without water, nothing could survive in the desert.
examples.zh: 没有水，沙漠中任何东西都无法生存。

examples.en: Without your help, I could not have finished this task on time.
examples.zh: 没有你的帮助，我不可能按时完成这项任务。

patterns.pattern: We were worried about + 名词/代词, who/which...

original.en: We were, however, worried about our nearest neighbours, whose farm was low lying and who were newcomers to the district.
original.zh: 然而，我们担心的是我们的近邻，他们的农场地势低洼，而且他们是刚搬到这个地区的。

examples.en: I was worried about my younger brother, who had to travel alone in the storm.
examples.zh: 我担心我的弟弟，他不得不在暴风雨中独自旅行。

examples.en: She was worried about her son, who was always late for school.
examples.zh: 她担心她的儿子，他总是上学迟到。

patterns.pattern: The first sign of + 名词 was + 名词/动名词...

original.en: The first sign of disaster was a dead sheep floating down.
original.zh: 灾难的第一个迹象是一只死羊漂浮下来。

examples.en: The first sign of spring was the flowers blooming in the garden.
examples.zh: 春天的第一个迹象是花园里花朵绽放。

examples.en: The first sign of trouble was the dark clouds gathering in the sky.
examples.zh: 麻烦的第一个迹象是天空乌云密布。
